google_calendar.title: Set up Google for this server
steps: Open the Google Cloud console, choose your project and enable the Google Calendar API (APIs & Services → Library).
On the OAuth consent screen add the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events.readonly. While the app is in testing mode, add your team as test users.
On your OAuth client (the one used for Google sign-in) add this authorised redirect URI:
Put the client ID and secret into the server settings: LK_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and LK_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, set LK_PUBLIC_URL to this site's address, and restart the server.
Come back to this page and press Connect.
